newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac to redeem debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac to redeem debenture issue.

text.p: Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp said Thursday that it will redeem the entire $63 million principal amount of its 8.045 percent fixed-rate debenture issue on November 22.
The issue was set to mature April 18, 2000 and has a cusip number of 3134005S8.
Freddie Mac said it will redeem the debenture issue in its entirety at a price equal to 100 percent of principal.
It said it will pay principal on the debentures along with interest accrued on the principal amount to the redemption date to holders of record as of November 21's close.
